# FACEIT Analyze

> FACEIT Analyze — professional tool for analyzing Counter-Strike 2 player statistics on the FACEIT platform.

## Overview

FACEIT Analyze provides detailed breakdowns of CS2 player stats, including K/D ratio, win rate, HLTV ratings, map performance, and match history.

## Main Resources

- [FACEIT Analyze Homepage](https://faceitanalyze.me/): Main analytics tool for searching CS2 player profiles.
- [Reaction Test](https://faceitanalyze.me/reaction-test): Interactive reaction time testing tool for gamers.

## Optional

- [Site Manifest](https://faceitanalyze.me/assets/site.webmanifest): Application metadata and resources.
